create_ClassificationEnvLikelihood: create a classification-based environment-based inference testbed with logit_fn and x_generators
build_gaussian_sampler: build a Gaussian x_generator that samples from a standard normal distribution given input dimension
build_weibull_sampler: build a Weibull x_generator that samples around an initial reference point using Weibull distances
build_polyadic_sampler: build a polyadic x_generator that samples with local structure centered around kappa anchor points
run_sample_gaussian_data: run sample_gaussian_data to generate training data with labels from logit_fn probabilities and compute log likelihood
